decisions.summary: GROVE_SIDES 5:3:2 and GROVE_SIDES_FLOOD 15:9:16 rolled per settlement, pinnable; flood_ground pinnable else polder archetypes or dike_top; recorded in meta, nucleated included; the generic Settlement rolls the same table
decisions.why: FR-005, FR-006, FR-009 and the nucleated edge case. Extending the roll to the other path that draws a homestead grove is what 'the homestead grove' knob covers.

decisions.summary: grove_faces(windward, sides, flank): two = windward pair (cardinal: face + a per-settlement rolled flank); three adds the non-front face; four adds the front; the front is the yard's face
decisions.why: FR-007 word for word; which flank a cardinal key takes is left open by the spec and rolling it from the seed follows the knob doctrine.

decisions.summary: The dispersed bundle carried from its NW canonical frame to the map's windward key by a symmetry of the square (SE by the anti-diagonal mirror, yard W); in every frame but the identity NW one the garden is laid beside the yard
decisions.why: Within, as round 1 ruled: without turning the bundle FR-007 and FR-010 cannot hold on a map declaring another wind, and moving the garden is forced by FR-010's morning-sun clause. The round-1 wording fix is made: the relocation now applies to every frame but NW, naming the NE mirror's west-wall case.

decisions.summary: Deep bands keep 1.57*hh; a thin band is one crown (17 ft, GUESS); east band set beyond the garden's morning-sun reach, front band beyond the yard's sun corridor; N/S bands full width so corners close
decisions.why: FR-008 leaves the thin depth open (spec Decisions: a GUESS). Setting bands outside the worked ground still plants the side and closes the corners; it is how FR-010's garden-sun and structure rules are met, not a side dropped.

decisions.summary: A four-sided ring's front band broken once at the yard's center for a way in about 36 ft wide (WAY_IN_FT; width a GUESS)
decisions.why: Unchanged in kind from round 1: one opening, on the front the spec names as the way-in side, is what FR-010 (every household seated and reached, no grove on a lane tread) physically requires of a closed ring. The width moved from 12 ft to 36 ft on a measurement (cohort seed 12: at 12 ft no route at cells 10, 5 or 3 and 14 of 17 farms stranded; the router keeps about 22 ft of the opening clear), recorded in dispersed.py and homesteads/715 as a GUESS set by that necessity. Four planted sides remain, so the ring the GM approved is not gutted.

decisions.summary: geom['groves'] list with faces and depth replaces grove_n/grove_w in every reader; a farm is seated only where its whole rolled grove fits
decisions.why: FR-010 and the spec's 'every farm carries its settlement's grove' decision.

decisions.summary: Manifest predicates grove_sides_complete, groves_windward, gardens_east_clear; cohort_audit runs them and the overlap matrix on every roll; a gate seed test on non-nucleated pool rolls
decisions.why: Enforcement of FR-010 and SC-005 only; with the requested behavior deleted there is nothing left for these to check.

decisions.summary: City/house-first path: _grove_room asks room for the minimal footprint of every rolled face; _solve_homestead seats a grove farm only with that room (the yard-and-garden-only fallback removed); _find_grove_arms plants every face grove_faces names; whether a farm has a grove stays the in-wall rule's and grove_prevalence's
decisions.why: Round 1's NOT LEGITIMATE finding is cured: no rolled side is dropped for want of room (FR-010, spec Decisions 'no farm quietly loses sides'), the seat is conditioned on room for the whole rolled grove as D6 does for the bundle, and the grove-or-not decision is untouched as required. An unseated farm follows D6's already-accepted rule. No longer a narrowing.

decisions.summary: Thin band drawn with the dooryard mix, deep bands the windbreak mix (GUESS for the ring); bands drawn as clumps of at most one clump's size, inset one crown on the house side; grove bamboo drawn only where the farm rolled a household bamboo stand
decisions.why: Spec Decisions: 'Tonami's tall cedar on the windward faces and lesser trees elsewhere'; the species mix and clumping are left open to the plan; the bamboo clause is FR-019 word for word.

decisions.summary: SETTLEMENT_FORMS restored to the 126 weights; comment rewritten
The five pool hamlets regenerate from unchanged specs, taking their seed's form and side count; settlement-review where layout moved

Record rewritten in two write sessions (homesteads 010/710/480; vegetation 030/620), checked by quote-check, record-format, source-applicability; modals by entry-drift; grove modal states the side count
The two nucleated overlaps the matrix found (seeds 17, 20) fixed whether pre-existing or regressions
decisions.why: Not an addition to the request: once the matrix runs in the cohort (D7), SC-005 requires every seed's checks green, and a defect found in the work is fixed under XIV. It narrows nothing.

decisions.summary: row_line knob and first-street choice as accepted at round 4; NEW: the dispersed hamlet's canvas grown by LINEAR_CANVAS 1.5 as the row's (a drawing convention, unused ground cropped), on the pinned Audit-905 seating 16 of 20 grove farms on the smaller sheet
decisions.why: The row-line content is unchanged from round 4. The dispersed canvas is a sheet size, labeled a drawing convention, whose only effect is to let FR-010's every-household-seated hold for a dispersed hamlet of grove frames; it moves no rule and narrows nothing.

decisions.summary: row_sides one/both knob; farms one frame apart, seats center-out through try_place; further streets are the first line set out parallel past the last row, holdings, lane room and field keep, the frame's depth along the normal; MAX_STREETS 6 (GUESS) with any farm past it reported unseated and failing the cohort, never ranked; a linear hamlet never takes the front-row, rank or rescue passes even with no street seated, and row_rules reports no_row_street; a seat is refused where its frame crosses any planned street, its door is within DOOR_ROOM_FT 16 ft (drawing convention) of hard ground, or it stands on a reserved holding; the placer nudges, never slides
decisions.why: FR-014, FR-015, FR-016 and FR-013's 'never in ranks behind the row'. Round-3 items 1, 3, 4 and 5 are answered and the code agrees (stages.py sets _rows_seated for every linear hamlet and both the front-row and rank/rescue loops stop on it; row_rules returns no_row_street). The street cap is not a carve-out: a farm the six streets cannot hold is not seated elsewhere or in a rank, it fails FR-010 / SC-005 in the cohort, so no map that breaks FR-016 can pass. The three seat refusals serve FR-017/FR-019 (a door a way can reach, a street the row can front) and FR-015 (the holding kept), and their only cost is a refused seat whose farm must still be seated for the cohort to pass.

decisions.summary: On BOTH, the far row's holding is behind its lot (street: a strip one frame wide and three deep in the near ring's plots; edge: one frame deep, compact, near the house), RESERVED at seating (placed box + block_polys ring) so later placers keep off; a far farm with no room for its holding is not seated there; only a canvas-edge clip or a single plot on water or a lane is dropped, never the whole holding
decisions.why: Round 1's findings are cured: the holding is behind the lot on both lines, compact and near the house on the edge (homesteads/156), and reserved so it cannot be crowded out. The one narrowing, a plot left undrawn, is taken case by case. A canvas-edge clip is forced by the sheet and is what homesteads/156 says a sheet shows ('only the near end of a 2,240-ft strip'). A single plot under water or a lane cannot be farmed; since the holding is reserved before later placers run, that case arises only where they cannot route round it. The holding itself is always drawn behind the farm, as FR-015 and SC-007 require. Depth and crop are GUESSES the spec already carries.

decisions.summary: Each planned street laid as one width-6 lane, street: True, joined at its nearer end to the connector or the previous street, exempt from the web's trims as the connector is; the connector runs on from the first street's end nearer the sheet's edge along its line; no skeleton arms or web cuts for a linear hamlet with planned streets; each row farm's way ends on the street its front door faces, routed round its grove where needed
decisions.why: FR-017 (one continuous way along its row, joined to the connector, a rank wider than the lanes, every farm reaching it) and FR-019. The trim exemption is what keeps the street one continuous way; the connector running on from the street is the join FR-017 asks for.

decisions.summary: farm_water knob (channel/well, even odds, pinnable as HamletSpec.farm_water, meta.farm_water); channel from the nearest supply ditch (never a drain) or the brook, shortest route over up to six candidate sources and every yard side, routed on an 8 ft lattice round buildings, yards, gardens, other groves, lanes, other water and the crop (as a wall), crossing its own grove into the grounds, ending a step off the threshing yard; drawn 2.5 ft in the supply hue (convention), recorded as farm_channels, kept clear; farms taken nearest the water first; an unreached farm draws a well and fails the check; well value by own_wells; row_water as accepted
decisions.why: FR-018 as amended (amendments 5 and 6) and the spec's Decisions: the knob as specified; source the nearest ditch or brook, or a channel already led off it to another farm (amendment 6, a GUESS); the end a step off a side of the threshing yard, in the dooryard (where in it a GUESS, the spec's). The routing lattice, obstacle set, source budget and processing order are mechanism, not scope. The fallback well is not an accepted gap because water_rules fails it (D19). The branching clause is ruled separately as D18-branch.

decisions.summary: A later farm's channel may be led off a channel already drawn to another farm (courses.append in farm_channels), now labeled a GUESS and carried by FR-018 amendment 6
decisions.why: The previous round's cure was followed: nearest-first without branching was measured (2026-09-30, Audit-19: 1 channel in 11; Audit-905: 20 of 20 either way) and the branching carried into FR-018 as amendment 6 with that measurement and a GUESS label. Amendment 6 was then tested against request.md as an exception: the GM asked that dispersed hamlets be rolled again with every farm drawn by the research, knobs and GUESSES where it is thin; FR-018's purpose (a dispersed farm carries its own water, a small channel led into its grounds) survives intact, since every farm still gets its own channel into its own lot and the water is still the irrigation water; the literal source list defeats that purpose on Audit-19, where a first channel walls the field's head off and ten farms go to a fallback well that fails SC-008; and no page read says where a house channel was taken from, so the GUESS contradicts nothing the record holds. Nothing the GM asked for is narrowed.

decisions.summary: row_rules, water_rules, doors_unreached (linear only), bamboo_mismatch as accepted; NEW: water_rules reads meta.farm_water - a channel ending inside the farm's frame under channel, its own well inside the frame off its way in under well; the cohort adds a pinned dispersed spec for each farm_water value
decisions.why: Enforcement of SC-008's dispersed clause word for word (the knob's value drawn on every farm, both values present) and of its linear and door clauses as already accepted; delete the requested behavior and these checks have nothing left to check (GM 2026-09-20).
